name: Bamboo shoot with meat
summary: Măng sặt xào thịt is măng sặt bamboo shoot stir-fried with meat, part of the Xá Phó home meal in Nậm Sang.
origin: Xá Phó households of thôn Nậm Sang, xã Nậm Sài.
howToEat: Share it with cá lam ống and the garlic bamboo shoots.
where: Xá Phó houses in thôn Nậm Sang, about 2.5 km from the Nậm Sài commune center and about 30 km south of town. It is a home meal, not a restaurant.
seoTitle: Bamboo shoot and meat at Nam Sang
seoDescription: Măng sặt xào thịt, bamboo shoot stir-fried with meat, at a Xá Phó home meal in thôn Nậm Sang.
